title: Quarterly plan: Private/VPC enterprise feature sequencing and OKRs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Quarterly sequencing and OKR tracking for Private/VPC/On-prem enterprise features. This ticket consolidates scope, milestones, success metrics, and cross-functional dependencies to guide the PM team and engineering/design partners through the quarter. The objective is to produce a validated roadmap with clear rollouts for RBAC, audit logging retention increases, private control plane upgrades, and onboarding flows for enterprise customers requiring air-gapped or VPC deployments.
objectives: O1: Reduce time-to-first-private-deploy for enterprise trial customers from 6 days to <=72 hours
O2: Ship RBAC and tenant isolation primitives to support multi-team enterprise orgs
O3: Achieve parity for audit log retention and KMS integrations requested by 3 pilot customers
O4: Validate operational SLOs for private deployments (99.9% control-plane availability) in staging
okrs: KR1.1: Onboard 3 pilot enterprise customers to Private or VPC mode by EOM
KR1.2: Automate 80% of network and credential setup in the onboarding runbook
KR2.1: RBAC: support roles and scoped keys for at least 3 common enterprise personas
KR3.1: Integrate with two external KMS providers and document key rotation flows
KR4.1: Establish monitoring dashboards and alerting with runbook for control-plane incidents
roadmap_items: Phase A (now -> 2026-02-15): Finalize PRD for RBAC, retention, and onboarding automation; design handoff
Phase B (2026-02-16 -> 2026-03-15): Engineering implementation sprint for RBAC APIs, audit-log batching, and KMS adapters
Phase C (2026-03-16 -> 2026-03-31): Private control-plane upgrade testing, pilot customer rollouts, and customer feedback loop
Ongoing: Console UX polish for private deploy settings and billing/usage breakdown in Redwood Console
milestones: M1: PRD sign-off and design approval (due 2026-02-01)
M2: Internal alpha of RBAC + KMS adapter (due 2026-02-25)
M3: Pilot rollout to Customer A and B (due 2026-03-10)
M4: Final runbook and handoff to support & customer success (due 2026-03-28)
metrics: Number of pilot customers onboarded - target >=3
Number of manual steps in onboarding runbook - target <=5
risks: Network configuration complexity for customer's VPCs may extend onboarding time
KMS integrations require legal/contract reviews for certain providers
Compatibility gaps between on-prem hardware and runtime kernel choices
Resource contention with runtime perf work (ENG-4102) could delay RBAC rollout
notes: 2026-01-15: Kickoff meeting with ENG and Design; aligned on RBAC scope and two KMS priorities
2026-01-28: Design review surfaced UX constraint for audit-log retention UI; added smaller follow-up ticket to DES-221
2026-02-05: Security requested V1 threat model; ENG to include in sprint docs (dependency ENG-4210)
2026-02-20: Alpha RBAC endpoints deployed to staging; awaiting integration tests and canary plan
2026-02-28: Customer A confirmed interest in early pilot; CS to schedule onboarding week of 2026-03-08
